captions.main_comparison:
F1 bars use verified runs; black diamonds count failures as F1=0. Exact recovery retains every planned run.
Recorded time includes returned failures; unknown times are omitted and labelled. Confidence intervals use clustered report tables.
captions.case_profile:
Methods and noise siblings share each day's trajectory. Daily replicate groups, not condition rows, are independent repeats.
Lines are descriptive stratum means. Failed/invalid/over-budget runs remain in exact-recovery denominators.
captions.dr_tradeoff:
Kappa changes the returned set, never the primary topology or its F1. No DR intervention was run.
Wrong-primary pair coverage measures an available correct alternative, not observed DR recovery. Undefined rates stay NA; no confidence levels.
captions.single_error_breakdown:
A separated saved alternative and no saved alternative are different outcomes. Neither proves global identifiability.
Failed, interrupted, invalid and over-budget runs have no verified primary and are excluded from this descriptive error breakdown.
captions.rte_heatmap:
Gray cells are not planned or have no verified F1; they are never filled with another method's result.
Module effects include the declared algorithm's stopping and budget allocation policy.
captions.ablation_effects:
Only pairs with both endpoints independently verified contribute to deltas; planned and paired denominators are displayed.
These bars are descriptive paired means. Clustered uncertainty is reported separately; module order is not re-executed here.

scope: Descriptive plots of independently verified finite panel; no new inference, refitting or DR intervention
